upgrades.name: Dawncrest Pegasus
upgrades.features: A tall backward-swept fan of pale-gold feathers continues from the forehead over the poll into the mane, with broad tiered gold-tipped wing feathers. Keep ivory horse body and exactly two wings; NO horn, no saddle, no armor. The raised swept feather crest is the unmistakable upgrade silhouette.

upgrades.name: Crownroot Runner
upgrades.features: Large branching three-pronged russet ear tufts form a visible crown, a broad cream shoulder ruff, and an enormous upright fan-like bushy tail with three distinct pointed lobes in the fur silhouette. Keep four squirrel paws and one continuous fluffy tail, amber eyes; NO actual wooden antlers, no clothes or weapons.

upgrades.name: Crested Serpopard
upgrades.features: A broad deep-turquoise and ochre fan-shaped mane/frill projects along the BACK of the long upper neck and behind the small leopard head; clearly larger neck silhouette than base. Keep long sinuous feline neck, tawny spotted leopard body, four feline paws and one tail. No snake second head, no extra legs, no armor.
upgrades.habitat: sandstone den at an arid river edge

upgrades.name: Dreamtusk Baku
upgrades.features: Two large upward-curled ivory tusks flank the short curved trunk, with a high swept-back cream mane crest and deep indigo body. Four sturdy beast paws; keep the Baku species and gold fur streaks. The curled tusks are visible and separated from trunk in side view. No saddle, no armor, no floating spell effects.

upgrades.name: Ridgeback Afanc
upgrades.features: A tall stepped ridge of three broad overlapping slate-green bony plates rises above the back and shoulders, with cream side whiskers and a wider flat paddle tail. Keep low heavy moss-brown beaver/reptile body, four short webbed feet. Natural bone plates, NOT metal armor; no horns, no tusks, no extra limbs.

upgrades.name: Crownfin Ahuitzotl
upgrades.features: A large swept turquoise fin crest rises from the head to upper shoulders; the long tail ends in a larger unmistakable WEBBED FIVE-FINGER HAND with turquoise fin membranes. Keep sleek dark teal-black otter body, pale turquoise throat, exactly four webbed feet and ONE tail-hand. No humanoid body, no extra tail, no jewelry.
